proved_but_absent_or_unorganized_human_c.topic: Different useful plans under equally leading resistance
proved_but_absent_or_unorganized_human_c.evidence: After Ke3 f6 Kf3, work4 returns Kd6 and f5 tied at White+573, with Ke6+591. The Kd6 forecast uses Ke2/Ke6/Kd2 and queenside exchanges; the f5 forecast uses exf5/Kxf5/g4+ and king support. The Ke6 forecast uses useful king approach and a central trade.
proved_but_absent_or_unorganized_human_c.missing_from_basic: The prefix-consolidation body names Kd6 and Pg3 presence but gives none of the resulting tasks or response-dependent conversion.
proved_but_absent_or_unorganized_human_c.limit: Do not insist on the old five-move cycle or the same current next king move. Distinct plans preserve a useful task in these finite forecasts; not every later response is separately closed.

proved_but_absent_or_unorganized_human_c.evidence: The current Kd6 forecast exchanges original White c3 against original Black b4/c5, relocates original a3 to b4, later uses original b2 to capture original Black c4 on c3 with check, and allows Black Kxe4. White king then captures the original a4 pawn after its checking advance.
proved_but_absent_or_unorganized_human_c.missing_from_basic: Neither these prices nor why prepared Kd2 makes that exchange useful are stated.
proved_but_absent_or_unorganized_human_c.limit: Original e4 and c3 need not survive permanently. Their loss cannot invalidate the whole idea by event-list mismatch; the new task/user/king race must be assessed at its own board.

proved_but_absent_or_unorganized_human_c.topic: Actual retained-arm central price and new use of the resource
proved_but_absent_or_unorganized_human_c.evidence: The equally leading f5 forecast contains exf5 Kxf5 g4+ Kg5 Kg3. Original e4 is lost after capturing original Black f7; the retained original g3 pawn checks the Black king and is then supported as a passer/king-route resource.
proved_but_absent_or_unorganized_human_c.missing_from_basic: The new pawn use/check and role transfer are not printed. Pg3 presence after Kd6 cannot stand in for this different leading defense.
proved_but_absent_or_unorganized_human_c.limit: Current finite PV shows useful continuation, not uniqueness or every conversion defense; no root sole-cause inference.

proved_but_absent_or_unorganized_human_c.evidence: After Ke3 f6 g4, work5 has Ke6, b3 and Kd6 all at0. The b3 forecast delays White approach, then e5 fxe5+ forces a king reply and lets Black advance its resulting e-pawn. The pawn remains on g4 initially but that survival does not itself answer the blockade.
proved_but_absent_or_unorganized_human_c.missing_from_basic: Only b3 and Pg4 persistence are printed, with no blockade, forced check reply or contrasting useful result.
proved_but_absent_or_unorganized_human_c.limit: b3 is one tied returned leader; do not claim unique strongest, or confuse it with the original first reply to root g4 or a different late book b3.

first_remaining_human_operation: Turn a completed owned option-value and resistance pair into the smallest meaningful consequence: which adequate defensive task survives or is broken, which friendly plan/user replaces the previous one, and what price makes the resulting activity useful. Merely replacing no-choice facts with original-pawn persistence after a reply is still insufficient.
original_root_connection_still_needed: The numeric root result is held, and the same f6 timing transposition is legally meaningful, but current original first-Black coverage and an explained response-sensitive plan/price chain are needed before attributing the original choice loss to this component. The root pawn advance and king preparation also change placement/turn; no isolated single-feature cause is proved.
